question: On one ordinary Prime31 public target, what natural-query relations, useful modular dependencies, complete scalar recoveries, and bounded failures occur for whole ordinary-auxiliary, supersingular-j1728 and Dickson fibers, matched plain controls, and dense versus retained tower membership?

claims.text: Each registered execution will report either an independently replayed complete scalar recovery or its observed setup, query, memory, deadline or infrastructure failure; no unattempted or censored cell is a negative efficacy result.
claims.if_supported: A recovered cell demonstrates only the stated finite public-target solve, with all its setup and failed attempts retained.
claims.if_not_supported: Preserve bounded and blocked outcomes with their original caps; do not infer impossibility or zero success probability.

claims.text: The pilot does not claim a speedup, a complete native-operation cost model, superiority to tuned negation rho, statistical significance, a best seed, or asymptotic scaling.

aa.not_applicable_reason: This pilot records diagnostic execution and exact replay outcomes. No clock or native-counter ratio is admitted as performance evidence. Separate L2 and A/A qualification is required before a performance comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Small-field correctness fixtures and adversarial signed-replay tests are preflight development checks, not additional Prime31 natural-query observations.

negative.not_applicable_reason: The pilot has no statistical null-population claim. Queries are generated independently of decomposability. Complete oracle negatives remain distinct from timeout, degree, solution and lift-cap unknowns; matched plain baselines are explicit registered arms.

factors.name: target curve
factors.how: Existing cofactor-one ordinary Prime31 fixture, independently checked by primality, nonsingularity, subgroup and Hasse tests.

factors.name: public target
factors.how: Prepare Q once from the public fixture seed, record generation work, and publish exact coordinates before any campaign run. The collector and oracle receive G,Q,r and never the fixture scalar.

factors.name: arity
factors.how: Four signed finite factor-base summands. Every possible sequential prefix identity chart remains in scope.

factors.name: coordinate fiber
factors.how: Retain every coordinate in the accepted auxiliary fiber. Record complete V, unusable x, usable column count c, full rational tower and independent fiber certificate.

factors.name: matched plain control
factors.how: Construct exactly c usable target columns using the fixed plain seed. Record reference construction as matching-design overhead, include it in campaign work, and keep it distinct from the plain algorithm's setup. Never truncate an auxiliary fiber.

factors.name: construction attempts
factors.how: Try initial seed plus attempt index, with every rejected build and available partial work retained. Ordinary trace-zero auxiliaries are rejected and charged. Process deadline bounds internal constructor loops.

factors.name: query stream
factors.how: Same SplitMix64 rejection-sampled alpha,beta stream for every IC arm, form alpha*G+beta*Q before decomposition. Preserve identity query targets as tagged observations. Never select queries by known decomposition.

factors.name: solver and caps
factors.how: Same production F4 and rational extraction engine. Degree512 is at least the degree256 dense membership input at depth8. No grid/meet-in-middle fallback may be relabeled as algebraic solving.

factors.name: replication and correlation
factors.how: One execution per registered arm on one target. Repeated plain configurations across reference seeds/families are correlated repeated configurations, not independent replicates. Three construction seeds do not provide an independent target population.

factors.name: execution environment
factors.how: Published source and bounded IsoLab command execution after admission. Two affinity-bound CPUs and two Rayon threads; diagnostic clocks. External TERM at 115 seconds plus 5 seconds before KILL implements the registered 120-second envelope; 4096 MiB address-space/RAM boundary. No unrecorded retry or cap escalation.

comparisons.threshold: Candidate must satisfy [d]G=Q under independent replay.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: No admitted performance ratio is computed in this diagnostic pilot.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Use panel order family ordinary, ss_j1728, dickson; depth6 then8; seed0,1,1093; dense,tower,plain within each group; rho last. Fixed serial order does not support wall-clock causal comparisons.

seed_derivation.note: The frozen native panel expands the explicit construction-seed grid [0,1,1093]. Each constructor retry uses seed+i for i<8. Every IC query stream restarts at4188; alpha and beta are successive rejection-sampled words modulo r. Plain seed0; one rho seed4188; target fixture seed20261122. Export actual seed and full cell parameters, not a cyclic canonical explicit_list interpretation.

instance_sampling.rule: One precommitted ordinary Prime31 curve and one independently generated public Q; no target screening or resampling based on solver output.

blinding.how: Explicitly exploratory deterministic pilot; no blinded inferential test. Code, inputs, caps and all exclusions must be frozen before affected data.

power.note: No statistical power claim. The55 singleton arms are54 fixed IC configurations and one rho diagnostic on one shared target, not55 independent ECDLP instances. Report cell-level outcomes and correlations; no inferential confidence interval or asymptotic conclusion.

primary.name: Complete scalar recovery or bounded status
primary.definition: Recovered means a candidate from natural relation collection satisfies [d]G=Q in both production and independent arithmetic. Preserve censored, setup-failed, killed and unattempted states separately.
primary.source: cell_summary.status, collection.recovery_replayed, rho_summary.independent_replay and external exit receipt

primary.name: Independently replayed signed relation rows
primary.definition: Every accepted row including duplicate coefficient rows; zero rows and identity-query origin remain visible. These are feasibility observations, not independently sampled successes.

primary.name: Factor-base rank, augmented rank and useful dependencies
primary.definition: Report rank(A), rank([A|-beta]) and useful dependencies modulo r. Rank(A) alone is not recovery; duplicate A rows can determine d.

secondary.name: Public-query outcome inventory
secondary.definition: Started, completed positive, complete negative, unknown and interrupted queries; partial results are retained. An unknown query is not a complete negative.

secondary.name: Available native work counters
secondary.definition: Separate construction, production group and field, F4, root extraction, polynomial construction, signing and modular row-elimination counters. Counts are partial and cannot be summed as a complete time/energy/cost model.
secondary.source: reference_build_result.base.cost, query_result.oracle.counters, collection_summary.group_and_field and rank work

secondary.name: Observed process and phase elapsed time
secondary.definition: Diagnostic total includes reference matching, rejected construction attempts, successful setup, all queries, extraction, signed verification and rank. Preserve matching-design overhead separately; no admitted speed ratio.
secondary.source: cell_summary.total_seconds_diagnostic, setup timings, external resource receipt

secondary.name: Observed resource and spend receipts
secondary.definition: Preserve assigned and observed CPU/RAM, peak RSS, exit code, deadline/kill state, job/pod/image/source identities, build/idle/failed-attempt costs and budget timestamp. Missing telemetry remains missing.
secondary.source: IsoLab launcher/job receipts, process resource receipt and account budget ledger

record: Full source revision and source-manifest hash; binary SHA256, image digest and exact argv
Frozen protocol, panel and individual cell hashes
Public G,Q,r and complete base definitions and independent certificates
Host/CPU/kernel, actual resources, job/pod UIDs, exit code and interruption status
Every query_start before solver entry, every terminal result or explicit absence after process death
All setup/retry/matching work and budget receipt timestamp; no missing failure is dropped

execution.queue: IsoLab existing Spot command-job route; access currently unavailable

placement.admission: No launch until current daily/monthly shared budget and reservations establish headroom, a finite original absolute deadline is recorded, published source and image are bound, source checkpoint is uploaded, and current canonical protocol validation/freeze succeeds.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly54 IC singleton arms and one A=1 rho diagnostic are planned. One execution each, serial; no retries. Additional settings or targets require a prospective amended protocol.

Each process is externally capped at120seconds total (TERM at115seconds, KILL after5seconds grace),2affinity-bound CPU,4096MiB and2Rayon threads. IC collection stops at64 attempted public queries,100seconds, recovered scalar, or fatal correctness failure. A query shares a1000ms cooperative deadline across charts. Rho stops at1,000,000steps or external deadline.

Total lane ceiling USD5 includes build, idle, storage, transfer and failed attempts. Do not launch when shared daily/monthly headroom is unknown or exhausted. Before admission freeze one original absolute campaign deadline; retries never reset it.

Any inconsistent fiber certificate, membership/sign-map mismatch, off-curve result, independent replay mismatch, wrong source/input hash, cap mismatch or missing launch custody invalidates the affected observation and stops the campaign for diagnosis.

No cap or seed adaptation inside this pilot. Preserve incomplete cells as censored. A positive first witness establishes that query's existence only; a complete negative requires all charts and extraction to finish.

decision_rule.text: Publish per-cell feasibility and work inventory. Complete recovery is accepted only after independent public-point replay. No complete solve means censored/not recovered within the registered caps, not failure of the mathematical technique. Compare dense/tower only within the identical whole fiber and stream; compare plain only at matched usable c while exposing nonlifting membership and setup differences. Do not pool duplicate plain configurations as independent replicates. Since clocks lack L2/A/A admission and native counters are partial, do not compute an end-to-end speed ratio or statistical winner. A later performance experiment requires a prospective L2/A/A and tuned-negation-rho protocol.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact public-point replay for recovery; all other outcomes retain their observed status.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell recovery/censoring, rows, modular ranks, useful dependencies, partial work and resource inventory.
decision_rule.interval: No inferential interval: one fixed target and no independent performance replicates.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Descriptive paired changes in feasibility, rows and scoped counters only; no normalized total-cost ratio.

inputs: Frozen panel and generated cell JSON
External process, job, source/image, checkpoint and budget receipts
outputs: Cell-level status and work table retaining every planned arm

graphs: Implementation and admitted-execution flow diagram; quantitative chart only after comparable admitted data exists

inadmissible: Calling this draft a frozen or current-canonical-validated protocol
Starting a campaign before publication, checkpoint, source/image custody, live budget and deadline admission
Treating local builds/unit tests or target preparation as a Prime31 research campaign
Selecting successful natural targets or borrowing a generic discrete log to derive their alpha,beta
Truncating auxiliary fibers or silently matching only nominal depth
Reporting incomplete extraction or omitted identity charts as complete negatives
Discarding duplicate A rows or equating rank(A) with complete recovery
Treating correlated repeated plain configurations or construction seeds as independent target samples
Dropping setup search, seed retries, failed queries, extraction, signed replay or rank cost
Admitting diagnostic wall time or partial native counts as an end-to-end speedup
Claiming comparison to optimized negation rho from the A=1 reference
Generalizing this one-field pilot to P-192,P-256,Curve25519 or asymptotic ECDLP hardness
